name: Roth.abs_eval_le
source:
theorem abs_eval_le [Fintype σ] (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {r : σ → ℕ} (hP : ∀ j, degreeOf j P ≤ r j)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : ∀ d, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ B) (x : σ → ℝ) :
    |eval x (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) P)| ≤ B * ∏ j, (1 + |x j|) ^ r j := by
  classical
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (abs_nonneg _).trans (hB 0)
  rw [eval_map, eval₂_eq']
  calc |∑ k ∈ P.support, (P.coeff k : ℝ) * ∏ j, x j ^ k j|
      ≤ ∑ k ∈ P.support, B * ∏ j, |x j| ^ k j := by
        refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ ↦ ?_)
        simp only [abs_mul, Finset.abs_prod, abs_pow]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB k) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ box r, B * ∏ j, |x j| ^ k j :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
          (fun k hk ↦ mem_box.2 fun j ↦ (monomial_le_degreeOf j hk).trans (hP j))
          fun _ _ _ ↦ by positivity
    _ ≤ B * ∏ j, (1 + |x j|) ^ r j :=
        sum_box_prod_pow_le_aux r hB0 x

what: An integer polynomial with bounded coefficients and partial degrees has absolute value at x bounded by B times the product (1+|x_j|)^r_j.
how: Uses eval₂_eq' and the absolute triangle inequality, enlarges support to box r via mem_box and monomial_le_degreeOf, then applies sum_box_prod_pow_le_aux.
hypotheses: Finitely many variables, partial-degree bounds r, and a uniform coefficient bound B.
